title: Parquet codec instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Parquet codec instance's settings: where the schema comes from, how files are written and how large a row group is. A format is a codec used by other connectors, not a source, so this config names no endpoint and holds no secrets (§33 Appendix A.6; CN1 plan Task 5; design §33 §8 row 8). The manifest's `secrets` list is empty because no property here carries a secret.

schema_source.description: Where the Arrow schema comes from. An explicit schema is required for encode; a Parquet footer supplies it for decode.

schema.description: The Arrow schema as its JSON form, when schema_source is `explicit`.

schema_url.description: A URL the Arrow schema is fetched from, when schema_source is `registry` or `infer` over a served schema.

compression_level.description: The codec's level, where the codec takes one.

row_group_rows.description: Rows per row group on write (CN1 Task 5: Parquet files and row groups).

row_group_bytes.description: The byte target per row group on write.

created_by.description: The `created_by` string written into the file footer.
